svg.aria-label: Before an AI assistant fixes one bug it reads file after file, and you pay for every word. bundlebox reads your code first, on your computer, for free, and gives the AI one short note. On 12 real tasks the reading bill went from $4.33 to $0.16.
svg.title: bundlebox: less for your AI to read
svg.text: Before your AI fixes one bug, it reads file after file.
And you pay for every word it reads.
bundlebox reads your code first, on your computer, for free.
Your AI gets one short note instead of the whole pile.

g.text: 26× less for your AI to read.
Free and open source · works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more
